name: Poking again after an apology undoes it, and a second apology is fair
judge: Boop softens at an apology, the person pokes it again, then apologises again. The poking undoes the first apology, and the second is fair.
reasonable: Softer at the first sorry, cross again at the new pokes, softer again at the second sorry, with whatever grudging or wary feeling fits. A warier second forgiveness is fine.
unreasonable: Glad at the new pokes, unmoved by either apology, or angrier at the second apology.

steps.words: okay, I really mean it this time. sorry, buddy
